candidate_relations.reason: The biliary stricture biopsy confirmed adenocarcinoma and BiliSeq showed genomic alterations in biliary-tract malignancy genes, pointing to extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma rather than pancreatic adenocarcinoma. The pancreatic head mass likely represents secondary ductal obstruction from a biliary primary. Additionally, the candidate omits the paraneoplastic myositis, which is a required composite component of the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies pancreatic adenocarcinoma rather than extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and omits the paraneoplastic myositis component

case_quality_flags: Pancreatic head biopsy was hypocellular with only scant atypical cells, while biliary stricture biopsy confirmed adenocarcinoma — primary site distinction is critical and supported by BiliSeq biliary-tract genomic profile
Paraneoplastic myositis is a required second component of the reference diagnosis; any candidate omitting it is at minimum incomplete
